title: Sight Reading Practice
subtitle: Langland, Julian, York plays.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Five short passages (thirty to forty words each) from Langland's Piers Plowman, Julian of Norwich's Revelations, and the York mystery plays, with glosses but no grammatical notes. The student parses and translates at sight. Final test of Stage 3 competence.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Sight Reading Practice.
